primary.title: Gold prices near 1-year low, silver slides as dollar hits 19-month high: Should you buy before wedding season or wait?
primary.summary: Gold and silver edged higher on Tuesday after a sharp sell-off, but remained near multi-year lows. A strong US dollar, rising Treasury yields and expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike continue to pressure prices.
